headline: European Commission opens consultation on revised DSA election-risk guidelines for AI and information manipulation
summary: On 10 November 2026, the European Commission opened a consultation on draft revised DSA guidelines for very large online platforms and search engines addressing systemic risks to electoral processes, including generative AI and information manipulation. The Commission’s consultation page summarizes proposals for earlier response to coordinated inauthentic behavior, pre-election recommender manipulation tests and six-month change records, persistent labels for AI-generated deepfakes, rapid removal of illegal candidate deepfakes, candidate protection channels and public post-election reports. Its linked draft PDF failed to load in the available reader, so this summary follows the Commission’s page rather than uninspected clause text. The guidance remains a consultation draft; adoption, implementation and election-integrity effects are not established.
